name: The Reykjavík EDITION
positioning: Official name The Reykjavik EDITION: a modern luxury hotel in downtown Reykjavik by the Old Harbor port
best_for: Travelers who want a harborfront base within steps of Laugavegur Street and Harpa
Guests who enjoy a rooftop, cocktail bars and a spa in the same hotel

facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Reykjavik by the Old Harbor port.
The hotel is steps from Laugavegur Street and the Harpa Concert and Conference Center.
Rooms and suites have views of the harbor, Mt. Esja and the Snæfellsjökull glacier.
Room decor uses ash wood and pale gray oak, copper details, faux fur rugs, and artwork and accessories from local craftsmen.
Bathrooms have enclosed rainfall showers and Le Labo toiletries.
Some rooms have their own outdoor terraces.
TIDES, the signature restaurant, serves Icelandic seafood along with locally sourced meats and ingredients.
THE ROOF is on the 7th floor with panoramic mountain and ocean views and a wrap-around seasonal outdoor terrace.
TÖLT is a cozy bar named after the fourth gait of Icelandic horses, featuring local Icelandic spirits.
The EDITION Spa has a hammam, steam room and sauna.
The gym is on the lower-ground floor and open 24 hours.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 45-minute car ride from the airport.
Spa access is for guests aged 18 and over, and there is an access fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
